Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/radare2/libr/bin/p/bin_omf.c","function":"check_bytes","line":50,"var":"buf[3] / rec_size","code":"ut8 str_size = *(buf + 3); if (str_size + 2 != rec_size || length < rec_size + 3) return false;","note":"Attacker-controlled OMF header fields are accepted only when the first record looks like a valid THEADR/LHEADR record; this gates the vulnerable parser path.","depends_on":[{"on":1,"type":"data","via":"input bytes"}]},
  {"step":2,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/radare2/libr/bin/p/bin_omf.c","function":"load_buffer","line":9,"var":"*bin_obj","code":"*bin_obj = r_bin_internal_omf_load (buf, size);","note":"The validated raw bytes are handed to the internal OMF loader for full parsing.","depends_on":[{"on":1,"type":"data","via":"buffer"}]},
  {"step":3,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/radare2/libr/bin/format/omf/omf.c","function":"load_all_omf_records","line":414,"var":"ct / size","code":"while (ct < size) { new_rec = load_record_omf (buf + ct, ct, size - ct); }","note":"The loader iterates over records in the attacker-supplied file and dispatches each record to the per-record parser.","depends_on":[{"on":2,"type":"data","via":"file contents"}]},
  {"step":4,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/radare2/libr/bin/format/omf/omf.c","function":"load_record_omf","line":387,"var":"record->type / record->size","code":"((OMF_record *)new)->type = *buf; ((OMF_record *)new)->size = r_read_le16 (buf + 1);","note":"The record type and declared payload size are read directly from the file and control which specialized parser runs next.","depends_on":[{"on":3,"type":"data","via":"current record header"}]},
  {"step":5,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/radare2/libr/bin/format/omf/omf.c","function":"load_omf_content","line":362,"var":"record->type == OMF_LNAMES","code":"if (record->type == OMF_LNAMES) return load_omf_lnames (record, buf, buf_size);","note":"A truncated LNAMES record is routed into the name-list parser, which trusts the record size while walking variable-length strings.","depends_on":[{"on":4,"type":"data","via":"record type"}]},
  {"step":6,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/radare2/libr/bin/format/omf/omf.c","function":"load_omf_lnames","line":77,"var":"buf[3 + tmp_size] / cb","code":"while ((int)tmp_size < (int)(record->size - 1)) { char cb = buf[3 + tmp_size]; ... tmp_size += cb + 1; }","note":"The parser uses the attacker-controlled length byte from each name entry to advance through the record; with a 1-byte-truncated record, this read can step past the available buffer and trigger the crash.","depends_on":[{"on":5,"type":"data","via":"record payload"}]}]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p)
